recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a 16-bit starfighter coasting through layered Sega CD parallax
something called Precursor stirring at the edge of the stack
city surveillance shutters closing on an expired contract
tributes for a man who once walked beside dinosaurs
summer fog holding San Francisco at nineteen degrees
agents waiting to be summoned from a phone shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Ride a stutter-house waveform through overcast summer fog — tap on beat drops as Fred again.. peaks surge and valleys swallow you.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap on beat, hold through sustained notes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each 45-second run is one perfect drop-to-drop loop; miss three beats and the track cuts out
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and waveform amplitude widens; ghost notes appear between real hits
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber fog gradients with pulsing neon waveform lines

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Pilot a Silpheed-style starfighter through scrolling parallax canyons, flicking to dodge laser grids and scoop precursor memory chips floating in the slipstream.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: physics flick to dodge and collect
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: flick in direction of dodge, tap to brake and scoop
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one canyon run = one chip chain; linking five chips without a scrape triggers a warp bonus
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: canyon walls narrow, laser patterns rotate faster, chips drift off-axis
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: 16-bit Sega CD chrome with CRT scanline shimmer

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Steer a yacht-rock dreamboat through three lanes of Enya-colored mist — switch lanes to catch Fleetwood Mac chord changes while avoiding driftwood and fog banks.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: survive one full song cycle (60s) without hitting fog; each clean verse unlocks a harmony layer
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: lanes merge unpredictably, chord-change windows shrink, mist density blocks peripheral vision
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: soft watercolor seascape with yacht-rock sunset palette

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw connection paths between iOS shortcut nodes before sunrise — link GitHub Actions triggers to Cursor CLI agents, routing around broken nodes that stall the pipeline.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to draw wire between nodes, tap to confirm route
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each puzzle is one agent summon chain; solving in under 30s ships the build by sunrise
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more nodes spawn, dead-end traps appear, countdown to sunrise accelerates
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: dark terminal UI with glowing node graph and dawn-orange deadline bar
